steps.code:
# Monthly rainfall data extracted from the chart
rainfall_data = [
    ("January", 88),
    ("February", 71),
    ("March", 57),
    ("April", 55),
    ("May", 49),
    ("June", 38),
    ("July", 29),
    ("August", 41),
    ("September", 66),
    ("October", 92),
    ("November", 97),
    ("December", 85)
]

# Calculate the average
values = [v for _, v in rainfall_data]
average = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"Monthly average rainfall: {average}")

# Find the month closest to the average
closest_month = min(rainfall_data, key=lambda x: abs(x[1] - average))
print(f"Month closest to average: {closest_month[0]} with value {closest_month[1]} (difference: {abs(closest_month[1] - average):.2f})")

# Also show all differences for verification
for month, value in rainfall_data:
    diff = abs(value - average)
    print(f"{month}: {value}, diff: {diff:.2f}")
